title: No invoice webhook is sent when a work order is closed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a webhook subscription for the test organization pointed at a request-catching page the tester can read. Subscribe it to invoice.created and invoice.paid.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, made before customer A was flagged, so an invoice webhook can be seen.
custom_steps:
1. In ShopView, close work order 1.
  2. In ShopView, invoice work order 2.
  3. Open the request-catching page to read the webhook requests.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is Closed.

Step 2:

  • Work order 2 is invoiced.

Step 3:

  • invoice.created arrived for work order 2.
  • Nothing arrived for work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11833 (Story 11, Open API and webhooks)

  • S3-R4: “No payment is recorded (not even the $0 payment a $0 invoice writes today) and no "Invoice paid" log entry is written, no customer transaction or receivable is created, no customer portal notification, email or invoice webhook is sent (the work order status webhook of Story 11 is), no invoice is sent to QuickBooks, the internal invoice is never listed in the Open API invoice lists and invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for it (both from the core release on, before Story 11), no tax, fee or discount is added, the shop supplies amount is not charged to the customer (it posts as an expense, Story 10), and the customer portal does not list the document (the portal vehicle list still counts a closed internal or no-charge work order for Last Service and Completed, as a service on the unit with $0.00 owed). Close and Reopen are recorded in the work order log as invoice created and reversed are today.”
  • S11-R3: “Webhooks: work_order.status_changed is sent at Close with the status closed and at Reopen with the status completed (today it is sent at completion only, so Close on a work order that is already Complete is a new emission). invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for an internal invoice; that part ships with the core release (S3-R4). Proposed for the API owner to confirm: Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable and Change category on a work order, Mark as No Charge, Change category and Mark as Billable on a line, and a change of the shop supplies amount send work_order.updated (defined in the catalogue today, never emitted) with the work order and its lines in the body; no new event type and no line-level webhook. The API owner also reviews the line fields of S11-R1.”
  • S11-N2: “If a consumer subscribed to invoice webhooks only, it receives nothing for internal and no-charge work orders; the work order status webhook is the signal.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
